description:
## Functional specifications
Update epic and children to supersede fanout, add strategy/canonical-storage prerequisites, and validate the DAG. Retain source-aware grants; inspect replace/mutate/public-revoke semantics and existing consumers. Add tests for independent sources, direct access rules, source-preserving Person merges, connector isolation and inherited thread access.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/permissions.ex; lib/zaq/permissions/resource_permission.ex; lib/zaq/permissions/channel_history_resource.ex; lib/zaq/accounts/person_merger.ex; associated migrations/tests

## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing Permissions APIs; preserve manual/provider sources and explicitly review existing mutation semantics. No separate membership ACL.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/engine.md; permission moduledocs

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Implemented source_key-backed independent manual/provider grant rows with migration 20260922000002; channel resource coordinates JSON(provider, config, external channel); direct-Person history grant check; replace/mutate leave provider grants untouched; PersonMerger preserves sources. Test-first regression: 72 tests/6 properties pass. mix q blocked by ExDNA.Credo Task.Supervised.stream(5000) timeout on full-repo scan after repeated retries; no code issue reported. No commit requested, keep ticket in progress until validation restored.

Validation recovered after concurrent CPU-heavy precommit finished: mix q passes with 0 Credo issues. Permission and merge suites 72 tests/6 properties pass. Keep open/uncommitted pending overall authorized landing.

Current checkout revalidated: 73 permission/merge tests + 6 properties pass, mix q passes, git diff check pending. Test-first fix: replace/mutate formerly accepted forged provider-sourced desired rows; both now reject :invalid_grant_source before any manual grants change. Engine documentation distinguishes implemented grant foundation from unfinished reader migration. Leave in progress/uncommitted pending authorized landing.

Broad #768 validation uncovered regression from source-keyed resource_permission migration: Ingestion.set_document_permission/4 still used old ON CONFLICT columns, causing PostgreSQL 42P10 in existing BO ingestion tests. Updated person/team fragments to include source_key; isolated previously failing BO tests now pass. Needs direct permission upsert coexistence regression, wider validation, and selective landing; no push.
